supporting_claims.statement: Jura makes legal hierarchy, grape identity and winemaking method unusually easy to compare in one small place: Chardonnay and Savagnin whites, three red grapes, vin jaune, sparkling wine and mistelle all coexist without meaning the same thing.

entry_points.title: Learn to recognize Jura without reducing it to a stereotype

supporting_claims.statement: Savagnin is a wine grape, not a cellar method. CARTA's primary sources separately document it in topped, non-oxidative wine, Jura's sous-voile and vin-jaune context, and sparkling-wine rules, so the grape name alone does not tell you how the wine was raised.

entry_points.title: Savagnin is a grape, not a style

entry_points.kicker: Same Energy · film yeast, different worlds

supporting_claims.statement: CARTA's sources document Savagnin in Jura's sous-voile and vin-jaune context and Palomino Fino in The Flor of Evangelho's flor-aging context.
